scope: Independent 32K TTFT profile. It is never combined with C16 into one strict resource/context comparison. Startup or KV-capacity failure invalidates throughput rather than lowering the workload after the fact.

numeric.weights: Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 target and MTP draft artifacts; record any reference re-quantization instead of hiding it
numeric.activation: native BF16 bulk attention with canonical F32 through the first 2048 prompt positions; record reference BF16 rules separately
numeric.kv: FP8 E4M3 target KV with F32 recurrent state; capacity work must not silently reduce precision

quality.gate: original 1024-case scorer with overall, zero-shot and eight-shot one-sided CP95 gross regression below 2 percent

resources.note: The 0.9 native default share and 32784-token ceiling apply only to this 32K profile with vision available. The reference per-step cap is 2048 while native derives its own cap; this is a declared implementation difference, not an equal-prefill claim. Actual byte budgets and KV feasibility are reported independently of C16.
